_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA ONLY. This is placeholder/demo data (MHC/MCC/IPS Test Set example) used to build and demonstrate the app. It is not real program data. Do not treat any names, requirements text, or part numbers here as authoritative.

programs.name: Test Equipment Sustainment Program
programs.description: Illustrative program record (PKM Migration Step 1) — coordinates the recovery/reconciliation project below. Not a real program name.

projects.name: Baseline A/B Reconciliation Project
projects.description: Illustrative project record (PKM Migration Step 1) — the temporary effort this workbench supports, delivering a reconciled Baseline B design. Not a real project name.

logicalSubsystems.name: UUT Stimulus/Response
logicalSubsystems.description: Generates and captures electrical stimulus/response signals exchanged with the Unit Under Test during automated test sequences.

logicalSubsystems.name: Diagnostic Messaging
logicalSubsystems.description: Formats and transports diagnostic status/health messages between the Test Set and UUT test scripts.

logicalSubsystems.name: Power Conditioning & Distribution
logicalSubsystems.description: Regulates and distributes DC power to Test Set sub-assemblies. Hypothesis based on IPS's apparent role; not yet confirmed against design-engineer knowledge.

logicalSubsystems.name: Rack 3 Assembly (legacy grouping)
logicalSubsystems.description: Pulled directly from the existing physical/rack-organized SSDD as a placeholder grouping. Captures which enclosure a CI physically sits in, not a functional boundary — not yet independently validated as a true logical subsystem.

logicalSubsystems.name: UUT Stimulus/Response
logicalSubsystems.description: Baseline B's own functional decomposition for stimulus/response generation and capture — independently validated at SFR, not inherited from Baseline A's subsystem of the same name.

logicalSubsystems.name: Diagnostic Messaging (Ethernet-based)
logicalSubsystems.description: Baseline B's redesigned diagnostic messaging function, standardizing on Ethernet-based transport (see ab-001) in place of Baseline A's proprietary serial protocol. Validated at SFR.

logicalSubsystems.name: Power Conditioning & Distribution
logicalSubsystems.description: Candidate Baseline B power conditioning function, largely mirroring Baseline A's IPS-derived allocation. Still Proposed pending SFR closure — the one subsystem that didn't clear SFR alongside the other two.

cis.name: Test Set (MHC/MCC/IPS Assembly)
cis.notes: Primary UUT test interface assembly; consolidation target for over-decomposed COTS sub-items below.

cis.name: MHC (Multi-Head Controller)
cis.notes: UUT-facing controller module within the Test Set.

cis.name: MCC (Module Control Card)
cis.consolidationNotes: Should be absorbed into Test Set CI; currently tracked as a standalone CI despite being a COTS sub-assembly with no independent verification path.
cis.notes: Vendor COTS card, no unique program requirements beyond the Test Set's allocation.

cis.name: IPS (Interface Power Supply)
cis.consolidationNotes: Candidate for reclassification as a COTS item record under the Test Set CI rather than a standalone CI.

cis.name: Legacy Diagnostic Bus Adapter
cis.notes: Not UUT-facing; scheduled to be retired in a future increment.

gaps.description: MCC (ci-003) tracked as standalone CI despite being a COTS sub-assembly with no independent verification path; should be consolidated into the Test Set CI.
IPS (ci-004) tracked as standalone CI despite being a commercial power supply module; candidate for reclassification as a COTS item record under the Test Set CI.
As-built Test Set (ci-001) decomposes stimulus/response function across MHC + MCC + IPS sub-modules, finer-grained than the SFR-agreed single-CI allocation.

requirements.statement: Test Set shall provide UUT stimulus/response interface per SFR-4.2.1.
No independent SFR allocation exists for MCC; it is implicitly part of Test Set allocation.
Shall provide module-level control signaling sufficient to support Test Set stimulus/response timing per SFR-4.2.1 (capability-based; no vendor-specific behavior required).
Shall provide regulated 28VDC output at up to 15A to support UUT test fixture power needs (capability-based).

verificationEvents.evidenceSummary: Inspection of vendor data sheet (Acme Corp MCC-200, Rev C) confirms capability is met.
Inspection of vendor data sheet (Volt Dynamics IPS-28-15, Rev A) confirms capability is met.

deltaMatrix.sfrAllocation: Test Set shall provide UUT stimulus/response interface per SFR-4.2.1.
deltaMatrix.actualDecomposition: As-built Test Set decomposes stimulus/response function across MHC + MCC + IPS sub-modules.
deltaMatrix.delta: As-built decomposition is finer-grained than the SFR-agreed single-CI allocation.
deltaMatrix.rationale: Sub-modules were introduced during detailed design for vendor sourcing reasons, not reflected back into the requirements model.

deltaMatrix.sfrAllocation: No independent SFR allocation exists for MCC; it is implicitly part of Test Set allocation.
deltaMatrix.actualDecomposition: MCC currently tracked as standalone CI in the CM tool with its own (empty) requirements shell.
deltaMatrix.delta: Standalone CI record has no corresponding validated requirement; over-decomposition artifact.
deltaMatrix.rationale: CI record was created early for CM tracking convenience and never reconciled against actual requirements allocation.

abCompatibility.baselineAState: MHC exposes a proprietary serial diagnostic protocol to UUT test scripts.
abCompatibility.baselineBIntent: Baseline B design intends to standardize on Ethernet-based diagnostic messaging for the equivalent interface.
abCompatibility.riskNote: UUT scripts written against Baseline A's serial protocol will require an adapter layer or rewrite before Baseline B TRR.

abCompatibility.baselineAState: IPS provides fixed 28VDC output to the UUT test fixture.
abCompatibility.baselineBIntent: Baseline B design retains the same 28VDC interface for backward compatibility.
abCompatibility.riskNote: No action needed; confirm at next Baseline B PDR checkpoint.

cotsRecords.functionalRequirement: Shall provide module-level control signaling sufficient to support Test Set stimulus/response timing per SFR-4.2.1 (capability-based; no vendor-specific behavior required).
cotsRecords.formFitConstraints: Must fit existing Test Set card cage slot 3; conduction-cooled per chassis spec.
cotsRecords.rationale: Capability is bounded by the Test Set's overall stimulus/response requirement; no need for a standalone CI-level requirement set.
cotsRecords.obsolescenceMonitoringNotes: Vendor has not announced end-of-life; monitor annually via vendor product change notice (PCN) subscription.

cotsRecords.functionalRequirement: Shall provide regulated 28VDC output at up to 15A to support UUT test fixture power needs (capability-based).
cotsRecords.formFitConstraints: 1U rack-mount form factor; existing chassis cutout.
cotsRecords.rationale: Commercial power supply meeting a bounded capability; verification by vendor data sheet is sufficient per program COTS policy.
cotsRecords.obsolescenceMonitoringNotes: Vendor lifecycle status last checked 2026-05-01; no obsolescence notice on file.

recommendations.text: Consolidate MCC and IPS as COTS item records under the Test Set CI rather than standalone CIs; retire their independent CI records after CCB approval.
Submit ECP to reconcile SFR-4.2.1 allocation with as-built Test Set sub-module decomposition.
Stand up an adapter layer (or plan a UUT script rewrite) to bridge MHC's serial diagnostic protocol to Baseline B's Ethernet-based messaging before Baseline B System TRR.

interfaces.description: MHC correlates captured stimulus/response signal state into the diagnostic message stream in real time; documented interface, not just an artifact of sharing the MHC CI.
MHC issues module-level control commands to MCC over the internal Test Set backplane.

sections.scope: Establishes top-level operational and performance requirements for Baseline A as a whole, independent of physical decomposition into CIs.
sections.applicableDocuments: Capability Development Document (CDD); program ConOps; SFR-agreed requirements baseline.
sections.functionalPerformance: Shall provide automated stimulus/response testing of the UUT across the defined operational envelope; shall report diagnostic status within program-specified latency bounds.
sections.interfaces: External interfaces to the UUT and to organic support equipment; internal decomposition is intentionally left to subsystem/CI-level specs, not restated here.
sections.environmental: Per program environmental design reference mission profile (temperature, vibration, EMI) — inherited by all subsystem/CI specs unless a tailored exception is documented at that level.
sections.designConstraints: None prescribed at this level by design — system spec intentionally avoids design-solution language to preserve subsystem/CI trade space.
sections.safety: System shall fail to a safe state on loss of UUT communication.
sections.humanFactors: Test operator workload shall not exceed program-defined thresholds during nominal test sequences.
sections.logistics: Deferred to CI-level specs; not meaningfully allocable at system level.
sections.verificationProvisions: System-level requirements verified via integrated DT&E; subsystem/CI-level verification methods are specified in those respective specs.
sections.notes: Illustrative/demo content only — not real program data.

specifications.title: Test Set (MHC/MCC/IPS Assembly) — CI Development Specification

sections.scope: Development specification for the Test Set CI, covering the MHC/MCC/IPS assembly as currently decomposed pending the CI-structure consolidation recommendation.
sections.functionalPerformance: Shall generate and capture UUT stimulus/response signals per SFR-4.2.1; shall format diagnostic messages for transport to test scripts.
sections.interfaces: Per ICD-TS-014; internal sub-module interfaces tracked in the CI x CI N² diagram (see MHC ↔ MCC).
sections.environmental: Conduction-cooled per chassis spec; see Delta Matrix for as-built vs. SFR-agreed allocation discrepancy on sub-module decomposition.
sections.designConstraints: Must fit existing Test Set card cage; COTS sub-assemblies (MCC, IPS) tracked as separate COTS item records pending consolidation.
sections.safety: No hazardous voltages exposed at UUT interface under single-fault conditions.
sections.logistics: MCC and IPS obsolescence monitored via their COTS item records, not restated here.
sections.verificationProvisions: Stimulus/response timing verified by test; COTS sub-assembly capability verified by inspection of vendor data sheet (see COTS Records).
sections.notes: This CI is flagged for over-decomposition consolidation — see CI Inventory and rec-001. Keep this spec's scope tight to avoid re-litigating requirements already captured in COTS item records once consolidation happens.

sections.scope: Top-level requirements for Baseline B, confirmed complete and bounded at SRR. Functional decomposition (SFR) has since validated two of three candidate subsystems — see sub-b-001/sub-b-002/sub-b-003.
sections.applicableDocuments: Baseline B CDD; SEMP (plan-001); Software Development Plan (plan-003).
sections.functionalPerformance: TBD — see A/B Compatibility Matrix for the specific UUT-relevant interfaces already being tracked ahead of full requirements definition.
sections.interfaces: Baseline B intends to standardize on Ethernet-based diagnostic messaging where Baseline A uses a proprietary serial protocol (see ab-001) — this is the leading edge of what this spec will need to formalize.
sections.notes: Illustrative/demo content only. SRR closed this spec's requirements baseline; it should mature roughly in step with Baseline A's transition from Development to Production specs — track that relationship via the A/B Compatibility Matrix, not by duplicating content here.

specifications.title: UUT Stimulus/Response — Subsystem Development Specification (Baseline B)

sections.scope: Development specification for Baseline B's UUT Stimulus/Response subsystem, allocating system-level stimulus/response requirements to this now-validated functional boundary (see Subsystems tab, sub-b-001).
sections.applicableDocuments: System Requirements Specification — Baseline B (spec-003); SEMP (plan-001).
sections.functionalPerformance: Shall generate and capture UUT stimulus/response signals per the Baseline B requirements baseline; specific signal timing/tolerance TBD pending detailed design.
sections.interfaces: External interface to the UUT carries over from Baseline A's ICD-TS-014 pending confirmation this remains unchanged for Baseline B; internal CI-level interfaces not yet defined — physical decomposition hasn't started.
sections.environmental: TBD pending Baseline B environmental design reference mission profile confirmation.
sections.designConstraints: None prescribed at this level by design, consistent with keeping subsystem specs free of design-solution language.
sections.safety: Functional Hazard Analysis in progress (see Safety Deliverables) — no safety requirements finalized here until that closes.
sections.logistics: N/A at this level — deferred to CI-level specs once physical decomposition begins post-SSR.
sections.verificationProvisions: TBD — verification approach depends on CI-level decomposition, not yet started.
sections.notes: Illustrative/demo content only. This subsystem cleared SFR; this spec reflects the resulting allocation, still Draft pending SSR review.

specifications.title: Diagnostic Messaging (Ethernet-based) — Subsystem Development Specification (Baseline B)

sections.scope: Development specification for Baseline B's redesigned Ethernet-based Diagnostic Messaging subsystem (see Subsystems tab, sub-b-002), replacing Baseline A's proprietary serial protocol (see ab-001).
sections.applicableDocuments: System Requirements Specification — Baseline B (spec-003); Software Development Plan (plan-003); Software Test Plan (plan-004).
sections.functionalPerformance: Shall transport diagnostic status/health messages over Ethernet per the Baseline B requirements baseline; message schema and latency bounds TBD pending detailed design.
sections.interfaces: Ethernet-based transport per the Baseline B interface intent noted in ab-001; specific protocol/port allocation TBD.
sections.environmental: Inherits system-level environmental allocation; no tailored exception identified yet.
sections.designConstraints: Must interoperate with legacy serial-protocol UUT scripts during the Baseline A→B transition (see rec-003) until an adapter layer or script rewrite is in place.
sections.safety: Functional Hazard Analysis in progress (see Safety Deliverables) — flags network congestion delaying a safety-relevant fault report as a candidate hazard; not yet a finalized safety requirement.
sections.security: Ethernet transport introduces a network attack surface Baseline A's point-to-point serial link didn't have — security requirements TBD, flagged for follow-up rather than deferred silently.
sections.verificationProvisions: TBD — depends on CI-level decomposition, not yet started.
sections.notes: Illustrative/demo content only. This is the subsystem most likely to slip SSR if its FHA doesn't close — track via the Safety Deliverables tab, not just this spec's status.

safetyDeliverables.title: System Safety Program Plan — Baseline A
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Loss of the Unit Under Test (UUT) due to an uncontrolled stimulus applied by the test set.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Governs the safety program's process, organization, and hazard-tracking approach across both baselines — established early and updated, not re-issued per baseline.

safetyDeliverables.title: Preliminary Hazard Analysis Report — Baseline A
safetyDeliverables.cdrlType: Preliminary Hazard Analysis / System Requirements Hazard Analysis Report
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Operator exposure to hazardous voltage during normal test-set operation.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Identifies candidate system-level hazards and allocates the resulting safety requirements before detailed design is fixed — feeds the System-level Development spec's Safety Requirements section (see spec-001).

safetyDeliverables.title: Functional Hazard Analysis Report — Diagnostic Messaging
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Diagnostic messaging function silently drops a fault report instead of escalating it.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Performed against the validated Diagnostic Messaging functional decomposition before subsystem design is fixed.

safetyDeliverables.title: Functional Hazard Analysis Report — Rack 3 Assembly (legacy grouping)
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: TBD — this subsystem's functional boundary is inherited from the SSDD's physical rack grouping and hasn't been independently validated, so candidate hazards can't yet be scoped with confidence.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Provisional: any FHA findings scoped to this subsystem inherit its unverified functional boundary (see Subsystem Detail) — do not treat as closed until the subsystem itself is validated.

safetyDeliverables.title: System Hazard Analysis Report — MCC
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Buffer overflow in the diagnostic messaging CSCI corrupts an unrelated memory region.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Verifies the MCC's integrated design doesn't introduce new hazards at its interfaces with MHC and IPS — this CI is flagged for over-decomposition, so check for causal-factor overlap with related CI-level hazard findings before closing (see CI Detail).

safetyDeliverables.title: Operating & Support Hazard Analysis — MHC
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Connector mis-mate between the MHC and an adjacent CI energizes a pin neither CI's design assumes is live.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Identifies hazards from operational and maintenance procedures around the MHC — depends on stable maintenance procedures, which aren't finalized until Production.

safetyDeliverables.title: Preliminary Hazard Analysis Report — Baseline B
safetyDeliverables.cdrlType: Preliminary Hazard Analysis / System Requirements Hazard Analysis Report
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Loss of test-set control over the UUT during an automated Baseline B test sequence, before the redesigned Ethernet messaging path is fully validated.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Identified candidate system-level hazards and allocated resulting safety requirements at SRR, against the Baseline B requirements baseline (spec-003).

safetyDeliverables.title: Functional Hazard Analysis Report — UUT Stimulus/Response (Baseline B)
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Stimulus generation function applies an out-of-tolerance signal to the UUT interface during a Baseline B automated test sequence.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Performed against the now-validated UUT Stimulus/Response functional boundary (see Subsystems tab, sub-b-001) — one of the two subsystems that cleared SFR.

safetyDeliverables.title: Functional Hazard Analysis Report — Diagnostic Messaging (Baseline B)
safetyDeliverables.hazardExample: Ethernet-based diagnostic messaging introduces a new potential hazard: network congestion delaying a safety-relevant fault report beyond the required latency bound — a failure mode Baseline A's point-to-point serial protocol didn't have.
safetyDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Performed against the redesigned Ethernet-based Diagnostic Messaging subsystem (sub-b-002) — still Draft since this is the subsystem most likely to slip SSR.

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Systems Engineering Management Plan
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Governs the overall SE process (reviews, baselines, decomposition approach) across both baselines — established at/before SRR, updated rather than re-issued per baseline.

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Configuration Management Plan
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Governs CM process for both baselines — the same discipline the Delta/Traceability Matrix and CI over-decomposition tracking ultimately feed into.

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Software Development Plan — Baseline B
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Drafted at SRR establishing candidate CSCI boundaries; updated at SFR to allocate software functions against the now-validated Diagnostic Messaging and UUT Stimulus/Response subsystems.

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Software Test Plan — Diagnostic Messaging (Baseline B)
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Establishes the test approach for the Ethernet-based diagnostic messaging redesign now that this subsystem's functional boundary cleared SFR — still Draft since the subsystem's own FHA hasn't closed yet.

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Software Design Description — Test Set CI (Baseline A)
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Documents the Test Set CI's internal software design, drafted at CDR — still In Review in step with the CI's own Development spec (spec-002), which is itself held up pending the over-decomposition consolidation recommendation (rec-001).

programPlanningDeliverables.title: Version Description Document — Test Set CI (Baseline A)
programPlanningDeliverables.cdrlDescription: Will record the as-built/as-qualified software baseline once TRR-era testing closes — still Draft, consistent with Baseline A approaching but not yet at System TRR.

checklistItems.criterion: CI-level System Hazard Analysis for MCC (ci-003) must be complete before TRR closes.
Requirement req-001 (Test Set stimulus/response) must have a passing verification event on record.
Functional Hazard Analysis for the Diagnostic Messaging subsystem (sub-b-002) must be validated before SFR closes.
COTS power supply (cots-002 / ci-004) capability must have a documented, passing verification method.
Power Conditioning & Distribution subsystem (sub-b-003) must move from Proposed to Validated before SFR closes.
Software Development Plan (plan-003) must be updated to allocate software functions against the validated subsystem boundaries.
Subsystem-level Development specifications must exist in at least Draft form for each validated Baseline B subsystem (spec-004, spec-005).
